recipes.task: Open Notepad and type a short paragraph about the ocean.
steps: Click inside the main Text editor area of the Untitled - Notepad window to place the cursor.

Type: The ocean stretches endlessly to the horizon, its waves rising and falling in a steady rhythm. Beneath the surface, sunlight fades into deep blue shadows where countless creatures swim among coral reefs and drifting kelp. The salty breeze and the sound of breaking waves remind us how vast and powerful the sea truly is.
Verify that the paragraph now appears in the Text editor and the tab title shows the document as modified.

recipes.task: Open Notepad, type the message "Dear team, the meeting moved to 3:30 PM (Room #4B) – please confirm by Friday!" and save the file in the Documents folder with the name NewJev_T01_notice.txt
steps: Click in the Text editor area of the Untitled - Notepad window.
Type: Dear team, the meeting moved to 3:30 PM (Room #4B) – please confirm by Friday!
Press Ctrl+S to open the Save As dialog.
In the Save As dialog, click Documents in the left navigation pane (or type the Documents path in the address bar and press Enter).
Click the File name field and type: NewJev_T01_notice.txt
Set Save as type to Text Documents (*.txt).
Click the Save button (Alt+S).
If a confirm-overwrite or extension dialog appears, click Yes/OK.
Verify the title bar now shows NewJev_T01_notice.txt - Notepad.
recipes.example_request: Open Notepad, type "Dear team, the meeting moved to 3:30 PM (Room #4B) – please confirm by Friday!" and save it in Documents as NewJev_T01_notice.txt

recipes.task: Open the existing file NewJev_T01_notice.txt from the Documents folder (e.g. via Notepad's File > Open or by opening notepad with the file path C:\Users\<username>\Documents\NewJev_T01_notice.txt). Do not create a new document. In the file, replace the text "3:30 PM" with "4:00 PM" (e.g. using Ctrl+H or manual edit), then save the file with Ctrl+S. (The existing file is C:\Users\prediQt\Documents\NewJev_T01_notice.txt — open it, do not create a new one.)
steps: In the Documents folder, double-click the file "NewJev_T01_notice" to open it in Notepad.
In Notepad, press Ctrl+H to open the Replace dialog.
Type "3:30 PM" into the "Find what" field.
Press Tab to move to the "Replace with" field and type "4:00 PM".
Click "Replace All" (Alt+A).
Press Esc to close the Replace dialog.
Press Ctrl+S to save the file.
Close Notepad (Alt+F4).
recipes.example_request: Open NewJev_T01_notice.txt from Documents and replace "3:30 PM" with "4:00 PM", then save

recipes.task: Open the existing file NewJev_T01_notice.txt from the Documents folder in Notepad (do not create a new document), replace the text "4:00 PM" with "4:30 PM" (use Find and Replace or edit directly), then save the file. (The existing file is C:\Users\prediQt\Documents\NewJev_T01_notice.txt — open it, do not create a new one.)
steps: In the Documents - File Explorer window, click once on the file "NewJev_T01_notice" to select it, then press Enter to open it (opens in Notepad).
If it does not open in Notepad, right-click "NewJev_T01_notice", choose Open with > Notepad.

Close Notepad (Alt+F4).

recipes.task: List the contents of the folder Documents\NewJev_T05 and report how many files it contains.
steps: In the Documents folder file list, double-click the "NewJev_T05" folder to open it.
Wait for the folder contents to load; the items inside are now listed in the main pane.
Look at the left end of the status bar at the bottom of the window, which shows the item count (e.g. "N items"), and note that number.
Read the names of the files and folders shown in the list (click the View menu and choose "Details" if more columns are needed).
Report the listed names and the file count from the status bar.
recipes.example_request: List what is inside Documents\NewJev_T05 and tell me how many files there are

recipes.task: Open the folder Documents\Rsm_Rini in File Explorer, list its contents, and report how many files are inside it.
steps: In the Documents folder list, double-click the "Rsm_Rini" folder to open it (or click the Address Bar, type Documents\Rsm_Rini, and press Enter).
Read the folder contents shown in the file list (Name column); press F5 to refresh if the list looks stale.
Click an empty area of the file list, then press Ctrl+A to select all items.
Look at the status bar at the bottom-left of the window, which shows the total item count (e.g. "N items" / "N items selected").
Note each item name shown in the list and whether it is a file or folder; subtract any subfolders from the total if only files are to be counted.
Report the list of contents and the number of files inside Rsm_Rini.
recipes.example_request: List what is inside Documents\Rsm_Rini and tell me how many files there are there
